intervention_description: A multi-faceted intervention providing livestock assets, cash consumption stipend, skills training, coaching, and complementary services to ultra-poor women in Balkh province

intervention_start.literal_text: Starting in May 2016, the treatment group received the full TUP package

intervention_end.literal_text: The program lasted for 12 months from the time of asset transfer

final_followup.literal_text: A follow-up survey was conducted from July to October 2018, approximately 1 year after program completion and 2 years after the asset transfer

graduation_components_rationale.consumption_support: Monthly cash transfer of USD 54 PPP for 12 months to support basic food needs
graduation_components_rationale.healthcare: Health subsidy including hygiene kit and medical expense reimbursement
graduation_components_rationale.assets: Transfer of livestock assets worth USD 1,136-1,488 PPP
graduation_components_rationale.skills_training: Basic training on livestock rearing and entrepreneurship
graduation_components_rationale.savings: Helped open bank accounts and promoted savings behavior
graduation_components_rationale.coaching: Biweekly mentoring visits providing guidance on business and social issues
graduation_components_rationale.social_empowerment: Activities encouraging community participation and linkages to institutions

outcomes.outcome_description: Total consumption in USD PPP per month
outcomes.literal_text: Per capita consumption increases by 30% (USD 24 PPP per month)

outcome_timing_anchor.literal_text: One year after the program ended-two years after assets were transferred
